package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/tag"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// TagHandler exposes tag endpoints.
type TagHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  tag.CreateTag
	GetByIDUC tag.GetTagByID
	UpdateUC  tag.UpdateTag
	DeleteUC  tag.DeleteTag
	ListUC    tag.ListTags
}

type createTagRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Slug string `json:"slug" validate:"required,ascii,max=255"`
}

// Create handles POST /tag/create.
func (h TagHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createTagRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	tagEntity, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), tag.CreateTagInput{Name: req.Name, Slug: req.Slug})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": tagEntity.ID, "name": tagEntity.Name, "slug": tagEntity.Slug})
}

// Get handles GET /tag/get/{tagID}.
func (h TagHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "tagID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "tagID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	tagEntity, err := h.GetByIDUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedID)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": tagEntity.ID, "name": tagEntity.Name, "slug": tagEntity.Slug, "created_at": tagEntity.CreatedAt})
}

type updateTagRequest struct {
	Name string `json:"name" validate:"required,max=255"`
	Slug string `json:"slug" validate:"required,ascii,max=255"`
}

// Update handles PUT /tag/update/{tagID}.
func (h TagHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "tagID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "tagID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	var req updateTagRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	tagEntity, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), tag.UpdateTagInput{ID: parsedID, Name: req.Name, Slug: req.Slug})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": tagEntity.ID, "name": tagEntity.Name, "slug": tagEntity.Slug})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /tag/delete/{tagID}.
func (h TagHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "tagID")
	parsedID, err := parsePositiveIntPathParam(id, "tagID")
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), parsedID); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

// List handles GET /tag/list.
func (h TagHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.TagAllowedFields)
	filters, err := parsers.ParseTagFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	tags, total, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), filters)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if tags == nil {
		tags = []domain.Tag{}
	}
	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(tags))
	for _, t := range tags {
		item := map[string]any{}
		if f.Has("id") {
			item["id"] = t.ID
		}
		if f.Has("name") {
			item["name"] = t.Name
		}
		if f.Has("slug") {
			item["slug"] = t.Slug
		}
		if f.Has("created_at") {
			item["created_at"] = t.CreatedAt
		}
		items = append(items, item)
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"tags": items,
		"meta": buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}
